name: Pipe re-scoping + trailing comment in a table_name argument (CVE-2026-33980 shape)
notes: TODOS #51. Reproduces the advisory's own PoC for CVE-2026-33980 (pab1it0/adx-mcp-server): get_table_schema's table_name argument is f-string-interpolated directly into a KQL query with no escaping. The pipe re-scopes the query to `project Secret, Password` (column exfiltration) and the trailing `//` comments out the rest of the original query. table_name is query-scoped (contains the resource-noun token "table"), so the key+value detector fires on the pipe+verb pattern.
